clips.title: The story
paras: Stonetalon Peak is an ancient night elven sanctuary tucked into a verdant alpine valley at the northwestern edge of the Stonetalon Mountains. Sacred to the kaldorei and cared for by local druids, it serves as the primary bastion of the Alliance in these craggy heights.

Perched high above the arid dust of the lower ranges, Stonetalon Peak opens into a lush, mist-shrouded sanctuary. Long considered sacred and steeped in ancient magic, the valley holds ruins dating back millennia to when the region housed temples honoring Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering. In the modern era, kaldorei Sentinels and druids have restored a measure of peaceful stewardship here, maintaining a tranquil refuge complete with a barrow den and a vital Alliance flight roost.

Beyond its idyllic forests and ancient ruins, Stonetalon Peak holds historic weight from the Third War. Guided by the visions of Medivh, both Jaina Proudmoore's human expedition and Thrall's Horde scaled these perilous heights in search of the elusive Oracle dwelling within the mountain's deep caverns. That fateful encounter forced mortal enemies to set aside their blades, laying the foundation for the uneasy pact that stood against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Today, the peak remains firmly under Sentinel watch, though Horde incursions in the lowlands keep the defenders vigilant.
